title: 1996 Yu-Gi-Oh! MRL-066 Turtle Oath Unlimited Common TCG
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
Enhance your Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG collection with the classic Turtle Oath card, a staple from the 1996 set. Featuring the iconic Spell-Ritual card type, this common card is a fundamental piece for both players and collectors alike. With card number MRL-066, this piece hails from the unlimited edition, a testament to its originality and vintage appeal.

Crafted by Konami, the Turtle Oath card comes in English language and adheres to the standard card size for seamless integration into your deck or display. As a proud piece of the Yugioh franchise, it's manufactured in the United States and holds the nostalgia of the game's early days, making it a prized find for those who appreciate the history of the collectible card game.
